# Licenses

`turf.min.js` is the browser bundle of `@turf/turf` 7.4.0 (byte-identical to the file in the npm package). It bundles
the `@turf/*` modules and their runtime dependencies. The license of each is below: the text of the license file in
that package's npm tarball, at the highest version its declared range resolved to on 2026-09-24 (`npm view`; the
bundle does not record the versions it was built from). Not listed: `@types/*` (type declarations, no code),
`commander` (the command line of `topojson-*`, not in the bundle) and `tslib` (0BSD; its helpers are not in this
Babel-built bundle).

## @turf/turf - 7.4.0 (MIT)

This text (the `LICENSE` beside this file) is also the license of each of the 116 `@turf/*` modules the bundle
contains, all MIT and all from the Turf repository (`npm view`; the files of `@turf/turf`, `@turf/isobands` and
`@turf/isolines` 7.4.0 compared byte-identical).
